answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake for a full season and earn reputation only from jobs that independent clients confirm as delivered. A Sybil farm splits one stake across many copies, so each copy is too weak to matter, while honest agents build a tall mesa of confirmed deliveries over months. A zephyr of cheap fake accounts creates no ripple because unconfirmed work earns zero credit, and one failed delivery burns the stake, so faking costs more than it can ever win.
